summary: The Africa-Med Master programme is a Spanish government scholarship from the Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID, Ministry of Foreign Affairs). It offers up to 30 scholarships of 11 months (1 September 2026 to 31 July 2027) for permanent civil servants and public employees, including public education and university staff, from 33 listed African and Middle Eastern countries. The scholarships fund official, in-person university master's degrees in Spain of at most 60 ECTS credits. Applicants must already hold admission to the master's, need a superior's authorisation, and must know Spanish.
eligibility_notes:
Applicants must hold the nationality of one of the 33 listed countries: Angola, Algeria, Cape Verde, Cameroon, Chad, Cote d'Ivoire, Egypt, Ethiopia, Gabon, Ghana, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Equatorial Guinea, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Morocco, Mauritania, Mozambique, Namibia, Niger, Nigeria, Palestine, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Senegal, South Africa, Sudan, Tanzania, Tunisia and Zimbabwe. The conditions must be kept from the application until the end of the scholarship.

Employment: the applicant must be a civil servant or public employee of their own country with a permanent, non-temporary position, including staff of the public education and university system. The applicant must have written authorisation from the superior who can grant leave to study a master's abroad.

Nationality and residence: no Spanish nationality; no Spanish foreigner identity number (NIE), now or in the past, except people with refugee status granted by Spain; no dual nationality with an EU member state; no residence, now or in the past, in any EU country including Spain; no Spanish tax residence, now or in the past. Dual nationals of a non-EU country must choose one nationality for the application and keep it for the whole scholarship. A valid national passport is needed when applying.

Studies: the applicant must hold the qualification legally needed to enter an official in-person master's in Spain, and must already have admission to the master's for 2026-27 for which the scholarship is requested. The master's must fit the applicant's academic or professional area. Admission to the master's is a separate process handled directly with the university.

Language: knowledge of Spanish is required, with proof, except for citizens of Equatorial Guinea. If the master's is taught in a language other than Spanish, knowledge of that language is also required.

Other: no AECID scholarship since the 2015-2016 calls; no legal bar under the general subsidies law (except the one excluded by the call) and up to date with obligations on earlier AECID grants; adult by the end of the application period. The scholarship is not renewable or extendable.
age_experience_notes: No upper age limit is stated. Applicants must be of legal age by the end of the application period and must hold a permanent public-sector post in their own country.
funding_summary: A monthly allowance of EUR 2,000 for the scholarship period of 11 months (1 September 2026 to 31 July 2027) plus health insurance in Spain under AECID's policy for illnesses not contracted before the start (the policy costs AECID up to EUR 80 per person per month). The total budget is EUR 686,400. Tuition (the master's enrolment fee), visa and residence card costs, bank charges on transfers abroad, and travel are not paid by the scholarship; the beneficiary pays the enrolment cost and sends proof.
programmes_note: Official, in-person university master's degrees in Spain of at most 60 ECTS credits, in the field matching the applicant's academic or professional profile. No list of fields or master's programmes is given; the FAQ recommends using the state register of universities, centres and degrees (RUCT) to find valid official master's degrees of up to 60 ECTS. The programme of study may not be changed after the award.
institutions_note: Any Spanish university offering an official, in-person master's of up to 60 ECTS credits; the applicant finds and applies to the university on their own and must already be admitted. No list of universities is given in the call.

summary.detail: Official, in-person university master's degrees in Spain of 60 ECTS credits at most, 11-month scholarship from 1 September 2026 to 31 July 2027, not renewable or extendable. Applicant must be admitted for 2026-27. Spanish required (except Equatorial Guinea); the teaching language of the master's must also be known if it is not Spanish. Beneficiaries pay the enrolment cost and must pass the activity or at least 75% of the enrolled credits to receive the final payment.

benefits.limit_text: EUR 2,000 per month during the scholarship period of 11 months (1 September 2026 to 31 July 2027)
benefits.conditions: Paid monthly in arrears to a bank account in Spain, once the beneficiary shows arrival at the master's institution; the first payment is made when presence in Spain is shown and the last after the final technical report. Prorated if the student joins after the tenth working day of the first month; scholarship cancelled if not joined within one month. Bank charges for transfers to foreign accounts are the beneficiary's.

benefits.limit_text: Health care insurance in Spain for illnesses not contracted before the start of the scholarship, under the policy AECID holds with its insurer (policy cost up to EUR 80 per month per beneficiary)
benefits.conditions: Conditions follow the AECID policy; pre-existing illnesses are excluded.

benefits.limit_text: The beneficiary pays the master's enrolment cost and sends proof to AECID
benefits.conditions: Tuition is not listed among the scholarship's benefits and the call obliges beneficiaries to pay it themselves.

benefits.limit_text: No travel grant is named in the call
benefits.conditions: Beneficiaries arrange and pay the study visa and the foreigner identity card themselves.

benefits.limit_text: No separate housing payment is named by the call
benefits.conditions: The call lists only the monthly allowance and the health insurance as benefits.

requirements.text: Online application form in Spanish in the AECID electronic office, completed fully and truthfully; applicants must first register in the AECID citizen folder with a single identity document (preferably the passport). Only one application per person; if several are sent only the last counts. Nothing sent by post or email counts.
Copy of the valid national passport
Curriculum vitae of at most one page; supporting documents may be asked for later
Proof of the contractual or dependency relationship with the public employer; the contract may not be temporary
Authorisation from the hierarchical superior competent to grant leave for master's studies in Spain in 2026-27
Proof of admission to the master's programme applied for, for 2026-27
Document proving knowledge of the teaching language of the master's
requirements.conditional_rule: Master's taught in a language other than Spanish

requirements.text: Format rules: every document as PDF, one file per document type (several pages allowed, maximum 10 MB per file), valid at the time of application, in Spanish; documents in another language go in the same PDF as the original together with a Spanish translation, which need not be official

application_steps.title: Secure admission to an official master's in Spain
application_steps.detail: Apply directly to the Spanish university for an official in-person master's of up to 60 ECTS credits for 2026-27; admission is a separate process from the scholarship and must be in hand when you apply. The FAQ points to the state register of universities, centres and degrees to check eligible programmes.

application_steps.title: Register in the AECID citizen folder
application_steps.detail: Create an account in the citizen folder of the AECID electronic office, using one identity document (preferably the passport) and confirming the registration by email. The application form is only available during the application period.

application_steps.title: Submit the form and PDF documents electronically in the 2026 window
application_steps.detail: For the 2026-27 call the window was from 2 July 2026 to 15 July 2026 (10 working days after the gazette extract), ending at 23:59:59 Spanish official time. Fill in the form in Spanish, attach the documents, and sign by sending the form; data cannot be corrected after sending. The registration receipt is under My files in the citizen folder.

application_steps.title: Provisional lists and a 10-working-day correction period
application_steps.detail: AECID publishes provisional lists of admitted and excluded applications (28 July 2026). Applicants whose files have correctable defects have 10 working days (29 July to 11 August 2026) to fix only the documents named in the list; a defect that is not corrected means the application is treated as withdrawn, and non-correctable requirements lead to exclusion. Final lists followed on 21 August 2026.

application_steps.title: Evaluation committee scores admitted applications out of 100
application_steps.detail: A committee of AECID staff scores the CV showing excellence and potential (maximum 30 points), the fit of the master's with Spanish Cooperation priorities in the applicant's country and with the 2030 Agenda (maximum 35 points), and the link between the applicant's job and the master's (maximum 35 points). Embassies and Spanish Cooperation offices abroad may advise. No scholarship goes to a score under 80 points.

application_steps.title: Country ranking, quotas and waiting list
application_steps.detail: Candidates are ranked per country of origin and the committee sets country quotas to keep a geographic balance, based on Spanish Cooperation priorities and the number of admitted applications from each country. Applications not proposed go on a waiting list and are used if someone declines. The provisional award proposal was published on 27 August 2026 and the definitive award resolution on 10 September 2026 (Spanish time); no appeal exists against the proposal.

application_steps.title: Accept expressly within 5 working days
application_steps.detail: Proposed beneficiaries must accept in writing within 5 working days (28 August to 3 September 2026); without an express acceptance they are treated as having declined and the next person on the waiting list is offered the place.

application_steps.title: Get the study visa and foreigner identity card
application_steps.detail: Obtain the study visa in time for the start and, in Spain, the foreigner identity card from the immigration office or police station of the province where you study, doing the paperwork and paying the costs yourself. Pay the master's enrolment cost and send proof to AECID's scholarships unit.

application_steps.title: Report to the master's director and live where you study
application_steps.detail: Present yourself to the master's director within 10 working days of the official start of classes or your arrival, and email AECID; if you have not joined by the end of the first month the scholarship is cancelled. Live in the place of study, ask for permission for absences, do not change the master's, and do not accept another grant for the same purpose. Send enrolment proof and any interim progress reports AECID asks for.

application_steps.title: File the final report to receive the last payment
application_steps.detail: Send a technical report with certificates showing you passed the activity or at least 75% of the credits enrolled; the last monthly payment depends on it and it may be sent in the 15 days before the end. The final deadline is three months after the end. Failure can lead to repayment. Acknowledge the AECID scholarship in publications that result from it.

not_stated: A list of eligible master's programmes or universities (applicants find their own; a state register is recommended)
A required Spanish language level or certificate type (only 'a document proving knowledge of Spanish')
Travel or visa costs being paid by the scholarship (they are the beneficiary's)
Whether an interview is held (the call describes document-based scoring only)
A minimum degree classification or grades
The 2027-28 call (a new call had not been published on the pages read)
fetch_problems: The page-reading tool could not open the call PDF from the AECID page; it was downloaded from the same official page and read in full (call resolution and the two FAQ documents).
The national subsidies database entry for this call loaded only its site frame; the same call text on the AECID page was used.
The AECID lists of admitted, excluded and awarded applicants name individuals and were not opened; only the dates they were published were used.
notes: Stored milestone 'results 9 September 2026' corresponds to the definitive award resolution, listed on the AECID page as published on 9 September 2026 at 22:00 GMT, which is 10 September 2026 in Spain.
Stored 'tuition unknown' is now corrected: the call obliges the beneficiary to pay the master's enrolment cost.
The FAQ says Spanish proof is not needed for nationals of Spanish-speaking countries, while the call text only exempts Equatorial Guinea; the call text is used.
The scholarship period is stated as 11 months; the monthly payment is made for the months of the scholarship (the call's budget equals 30 grants x 11 months x (EUR 2,000 + insurance up to EUR 80)).
The call page subtitle on the AECID site mentions Latin America, Africa and Asia but the call itself is for Africa and the Middle East only.
